liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (2 reviews): The performance of the half-step song is described as soaring and top notch; Jerry Garcia is noted for delivering a strong performance of the half-step song [10][13]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-12-30.139533.aud.troy.miller.smith.sirmick.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 153 min [1]
- **gd1977-12-30.132379.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 168 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: The recording is praised for having very nice sound quality; The sound quality of the Winterland recording is described as perfect; Charlie Miller's soundboard recording is noted for its excellent sound quality [14][15][17]
- **gd1977-12-30.142698.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 172 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: The matrix combines the clarity of the soundboard with the gut-punch of the audience [20]
- **gd1977-12-30.GEMS.Taback.partial.112745.flac16**: audience recording; 9 songs; 74 min [8]. Said about its sound: The cassette master is described as quite good sounding with both channels present [8]

## Around the show

- The Grateful Dead were rocking the audience throughout the house during the show [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-12-30.139533.aud.troy.miller.smith.sirmick.flac24**: taped by Sandy Troy; transferred by Charlie Miller and Matt Smith and SIRMick; source: Source: Tandberg 10X reel to reel @ 7.5 ips Master. The reel is from Sandy Troy's collection and was provided by Charlie Miller; Transfer: Master reel >… [1]. Also: This is the only complete version in circulation, as the soundboard has a splice [1]
- **gd1977-12-30.132379.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> FLAC [4]
- **gd1977-12-30.142698.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: flac16/48kHz ; 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound (48k) - SBD (shnid = 139536) Recording Info: SBD > Master Reel > Dat > FLAC; Transfer Info: FLAC > Samplitude… [5]
- **gd1977-12-30.GEMS.Taback.partial.112745.flac16**: taped by Gene Taback; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Audience Recording by Gene Taback; One Casette Master Transferred by Jim Blackwood at 24bit 96 kHz Edited and Mastered by Jamie Waddell Weiss-Saracon for 16… [8]. Also: The uploader recorded a cassette master at Winterland, selecting only songs they wanted to hear [8]
